correctness.rationale: Exact orthonormal-basis shift weights and the rational identity (1) give a diagonal selfcommutator with the sign of a linear polynomial on a geometric lattice unbounded toward both endpoints; checking both coefficients is necessary and sufficient. Cauchy–Schwarz reduces the inequalities to the exact disk even for zero coefficients. Adjoint handles negative Fourier winding; geometric two-sided Laurent tails imply every Schatten p, and finite telescoping proves trace k(|A|²-|B|²). Normality forces vanishing amplitudes. 41,815 exact rational finite diagnostics run; these are supplementary and not substituted for the infinite proof.

value.rationale: A natural first nonanalytic Fourier family of annular Hardy Toeplitz symbols has two independently specifiable complex boundary values. An exact sharp phase-dependent hyponormality disk across all annulus moduli and Fourier indices completely solves that family, with a signed trace and normality rigidity. It distinguishes genuinely nonanalytic hyponormal examples from analytic multiplier subfamilies; the invariant and question arise directly from contemporary annular Toeplitz and commutator research, rather than a contrived numerical slice.
